caption:
India Inc entered this July–September quarter with its hiring outlook down 20 points. That quarter closes 30 September.

When external hiring slows, the slots don't disappear — they move inside. Internal promotions replace new headcount. Which means the decision gets made in a review room, by people describing you in a sentence or two while you're not there.

That sentence is not built on your output. It's built on how you held the room the last time something was at stake. Bearing. Tone. Whether you filled silence or used it.

Q2 closing reviews, half-year check-ins and Q4 planning land in the next 10–14 days. Fewer slots means the gap between qualified and perceived-as-ready costs you more than it did last quarter.

Walk into those rooms as the person already carrying the next role. Command is a practice, not a personality.

topic.title: Cautious quarter closes: fewer slots, decided in review rooms
topic.angle: In a cautious hiring quarter internal moves replace external hiring, so promotion decisions rest on perceived readiness — and "qualified but overlooked" costs most when there are fewer slots to win.
